module_summary: Register-file RAM for SERV: a single-port-write, synchronous-read memory array with a registered read port that masks reads of register x0 to zero.

anchors.name: memory
anchors.why: RAM array holding register file and CSR bits, written at i_waddr when i_wen

anchors.name: o_rdata
anchors.why: read data output, registered rdata masked by regzero

anchors.name: i_raddr
anchors.why: read address into memory; upper bits detect register x0

anchors.name: i_ren
anchors.why: read enable selecting memory read into rdata

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: synchronous read register capturing memory output every cycle

anchors.name: regzero
anchors.why: registered x0 detect forcing o_rdata to zero

groups.name: Register RAM
groups.description: Memory array with write port and registered read port

groups.name: x0 read masking
groups.description: Zeroes read data when register x0 is addressed
